gbifID.description: Numeric global biodiversity record identifier assigned by GBIF for each observation.

datasetKey.description: Constant dataset identifier associating all records with the same GBIF dataset.

occurrenceID.description: Unique iNaturalist observation URLs identifying each Asemosyrphus mexicanus record.

phylum.description: Taxonomic rank grouping all records under the Arthropoda classification.

class.description: Taxonomic class of the organism, always Insecta.

species.description: Scientific name of the observed hoverfly species, consistently Asemosyrphus mexicanus.

infraspecificEpithet.description: Infraspecific epithet field is empty for all records.

taxonRank.description: Taxonomic rank of the observation, always species.

verbatimScientificName.description: Scientific name of the observed species, consistently Asemosyrphus mexicanus.

countryCode.description: Country code of observation location using ISO two‑letter identifiers.

locality.description: Locality information is missing for all records.

stateProvince.description: State or province where each Asemosyrphus mexicanus observation was recorded.

occurrenceStatus.description: All records denote presence of the species at the observation site.

individualCount.description: No data recorded for individual count in this dataset.

coordinatePrecision.description: Coordinate precision values are missing for all records.

elevationAccuracy.description: Elevation accuracy data not provided for any observation.

depth.description: Depth data missing for all records.

speciesKey.description: Species identifier code for Asemosyrphus mexicanus observations.

basisOfRecord.description: Record source is human observation for all entries.

collectionCode.description: Dataset collection identifier consistently set to “Observations” for all records.

recordNumber.description: Record identifier is missing for all entries.

dateIdentified.description: Identification date and time of each observation.

license.description: License for data reuse, using Creative Commons CC BY‑NC 4.0 or CC BY 4.0.

sample_values: Grupo Monitoreo Biodiversidad SDA, Bogotá D.C., Colombia
recordedBy.description: Names of observers or contributing entities who recorded each Asemosyrphus mexicanus observation.

typeStatus.description: All entries lack type status data.
